name: Crawler API and MCP
ownerWords:
is all apis working that work in crawler api work for api portal? (API portal chat, 10-12)
make the crawler durable: like crash(?) or something changed for couple hours ... automatic failure mechanisms -> GO, docker up, crawler all back up to speed. (10-19, msg mvfe8foz)
virev.ai MCP that lets a customer's agent read-query the whole crawled index freely (10-15). And 10-15 23:58Z: "select만 되는게 아니라 \"팔로워 구간별로 좋아요 수 비율 분석해줘\" 이런 group by analytics도 되는거지??"
Duties suggestion ... merge Crawler API & Query MCP (10-22, msg mvj491h5)
goal: A customer's calls to the prod crawler API and to the virev.ai query MCP answer: the API stays up through deploys, its health check answers, every documented route that fails on prod for a crawler reason gets fixed, and describe, sql, search and the owner's follower-bucket sql answer through prod https://virev.ai/mcp on the standard and the full tier. Three API faults kept coming back in the Crawler VP chat: deploys took the API down for about 5 minutes (p128, 27 runs of the job crawler zero downtime deploy), the health snapshots failed or read over 2 s (26 alert steps from 10-17 to 10-19, p139, p867), and documented routes failed their own examples (p144, p261, p848, 15 runs of live route parity fixes). Goal p542 closed on 10-21 with 3 of 3 MCP tools and the follower-bucket sql on both tiers, and this duty keeps it. The precheck runs auto-sns-agent scripts/duties/crawler/crawler-api.mjs, which reads prod Prometheus through obs.virev.ai for the two down counts and prod_routes_crawler from the newest detail file of the API portal chat's duty d2 Portal matches crawler, then calls prod /mcp as the prod test user mcp-duty-checker (orgs org_mcp_duty_standard and org_mcp_duty_full), which stays for this duty. The onboarding render count keeps the closed p1076 (busy signups still get countries and prices). The duty holds one headline and 3 supporting metrics (c75, c133), so the Instagram posts count behind the prod alias crawler_v3_posts, which keeps the closed p689, is a detail line of each run.

metrics.label: Prod crawler API routes and MCP tools failing
metrics.why: A failing documented route or MCP call is what a customer hits. It is prod_routes_crawler from the newest d2 detail file of chat 01a1301d-18de-7129-a559-cfb92f9b5fb1 plus each of the 8 MCP calls (describe, sql, search, follower-bucket sql on 2 tiers) that fails on prod. Before the merge, d6 read 2 failing routes on 10-21 00:43Z and d10 read 3 of 3 tools and 2 of 2 follower-bucket tiers on 10-21 14:33Z.

metrics.label: Minutes the prod crawler API failed its Prometheus scrape in 24 h, deploys included
metrics.why: sum_over_time((1 - up{job="crawler-v3",instance="crawler-api:8787"})[24h:1m]) on estate_prometheus, where a minute with no up sample counts as down too. It read 4 min at 15:36Z and 5 min at 16:50Z on 10-19, both from deploys.

metrics.label: Minutes in 24 h with any prod crawler health snapshot down
metrics.why: sum_over_time(((count(crawler_v3_health_snapshot_up{world="prod"}==0)>bool 0) or vector(0))[24h:1m]). It read 1,323 of 1,440 min at 15:36Z on 10-19, and at 16:50Z tiktok_shop_frontier (1,143 min), instagram_census (805) and watch_targets (762) were down the longest.

metrics.label: Onboarding shop page renders under 60 s when 3 run at once on the prod crawler
metrics.why: 3 POST /api/crawl/fetch renders at once on the bloomandwild.com homepage, terms-and-privacy and delivery-information pages, the bodies onboarding's renderPage sends, counting those that answer a page under its 60 s RENDER_MS (convex/search/brandTracking/catalog.ts). p1076 met it on staging at 14:25Z on 10-28 with 6 render slots: 9 of 9 under 60 s, slowest 41.7 s. On 1 slot two legal renders took 61.6 and 69.6 s. Read by auto-sns-agent scripts/duties/crawler/crawler-api.mjs, which sends a legal page's settle_min_text and, like renderPage, sends the render again without it when the crawler refuses it as extra. The first prod reading, 10-28 16:17Z on prod 2637dd2a, was 3 of 3, slowest 55.3 s, with both legal renders sent again without settle_min_text.

onMiss: Each missed metric gets a live fix job this run (c75), or a message to the live job that already owns its cause. prod_routes_and_mcp_tools_failing: the flagged lines name each failing route and MCP call. A failing route goes to p848, p144 or p261 with the routes the flagged line names, or to a new fix step under p146 with duty set to this metric. A failing MCP call: HTTP 401 or invalid_token means the duty identity or the signing secret changed, so re-create the connection with /api/mcp/connection/upsert and the dataApi grant with the org-contract route (c35). 'not configured', 'denied' or an upstream 5xx means crawler-api, its QUERY_* URLs in apps/crawler-v3/.env or the ClickHouse query users broke, so name the release that changed it and fix it through the crawler ops train; the ClickHouse users come back with deploy.sh's apply_query_mcp.py step. A follower-bucket timeout or max_bytes_to_read on a tier means q.instagram_post_counts outgrew that tier's limits, so start one fix job that makes the follower-bucket answer fit, as p880 did, and land it through the train. api_down_minutes_24h: a deploy outage goes to the fix step p128, with the down spans from the flagged line. health_snapshot_down_minutes_24h: a down snapshot goes to p139 or p867, worst snapshot first from the per-snapshot minutes. The Instagram posts detail line is no metric: a count under 1,007M or 0, such as the crawler_v3_posts alias turned off, gets a fix step under p827. onboarding_renders_3x_under_60s: a count under 3 goes to the crawler ops train with the slowest seconds and each render's note from the flagged line. A render past 60 s means the prod crawler has too few render slots: commit 02ed5eeca gives prod 6 and rides p980 to prod, so until p980's promote a miss is the true state and stays with that train. An HTTP 401 means the search app's CRAWLER_API_KEY in the working tree differs from the one prod accepts. Fix each cause in code and land it through the crawler ops train. A source_error comes first: fix scripts/duties/crawler-api-mcp.ts, or auto-sns-agent scripts/duties/crawler/crawler-api.mjs when its read failed; when GRAFANA_AGENT_TOKEN cannot read estate_prometheus, the Grafana admin login in apps/infra/aws/secrets.env reads the same queries by hand. A d2 detail file many hours old means the API portal chat's duty d2 stopped running, so tell that chat. Never pause or write prod, never touch live :5182, never ssh to us-metal01 (c146), and nothing goes to an outside party. All on target: end the turn with no message.
